description:
Get the instances of role eligibilities.

TIP: Lists PIM (Privileged Identity Management) eligible role assignments. These are just-in-time assignments that users must activate. Use $filter=principalId eq '{user-id}' to find eligible roles for a specific user. Use $expand=roleDefinition to get role names. Compare with list-role-assignments to distinguish permanent vs eligible assignments.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

top.description: Page size (Graph $top). Start small (5-15) so responses fit the model context. Use @odata.nextLink from the response for more rows.

name: list-pim-eligible-assignments
